summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a lecture on the importance of the Asr (afternoon) prayer, known as Al-Salat Al-Wusta (the middle prayer) as mentioned in the Quran. He discusses multiple hadiths emphasizing the critical nature of this prayer, including a narration from Anas ibn Malik about the Prophet Muhammad's practice of praying Asr while the sun was still high in the sky. Sh. Ali Mashhour presents hadiths from Ibn Umar and Buraidah ibn Al-Hasib that warn of severe consequences for neglecting the Asr prayer, stating that whoever misses it is as if they have lost their family and wealth, and that failing to pray it voids one's deeds.
